Class GTMcpReadTools

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.mcp.GTMcpReadTools
@Component @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="gt.use", name="mcp", havingValue="true") public class GTMcpReadTools extends Object
The reading tools of the MCP server. Each method only names the tool, describes it for the model and hands its body to McpToolExecutor, which applies the limits and turns the outcome into a tool result. The work is done by McpReadToolService.

The descriptions are part of the contract with the model: they name the fields, the currency, the scaling of percentages and the meaning of the date, because a model cannot ask what a number means.

    • accountSummary

      @McpTool(name="account_summary", description="Values of all portfolios at a date, grouped by portfolio or by currency: per cash account the cash balance, the value and gain/loss of the securities booked against it, and gainLossCurrencyMC, the currency result of the cash account. totals sum the whole tenant. valuationComplete is false when an exchange rate is missing (missingExchangeRates).Fields ending in MC are amounts in the main currency (mainCurrency); amounts without MC are in the currency of the instrument or account. Percentages are percentage points (12.5 means 12.5 %). Dates are yyyy-MM-dd. When untilDate is omitted, today in the client's time zone (header x-time-zone, otherwise UTC) is used; the answer names the resolved date and zone.", annotations=) public io.modelcontextprotocol.spec.McpSchema.CallToolResult accountSummary(@McpToolParam(required=false,description="Valuation date yyyy-MM-dd, default today") String untilDate, @McpToolParam(required=false,description="portfolio (default) or currency") String groupBy)

    • holdings

      @McpTool(name="holdings", description="Security positions at a date, one row per position, with units, closePrice and closeDate, value (valueSecurity in the instrument currency, valueMC), gainLossSecurityMC and gainLossCurrencyMC. gainLossCurrencyMC is the cumulative currency result of the position since it was opened, valued at the date; a value for a calendar year cannot be derived from it, not even as the difference of two dates when positions were opened or closed in between. shareOfTotalPercentage is the share of the position in the total. priceMissing true means no price or exchange rate was found and the row is valued with a substitute; totals containing such a row carry valuationComplete false. groupBy adds the column group and the separate groupTotals, it does not merge positions. totalsOfAllPositions sum all positions, not the page. orderBy: valueMC, gainLossMC, gainLossCurrencyMC, shareOfTotalPercentage or name, optionally followed by :asc or :desc (default valueMC:desc). Fields ending in MC are amounts in the main currency (mainCurrency); amounts without MC are in the currency of the instrument or account. Percentages are percentage points (12.5 means 12.5 %). Dates are yyyy-MM-dd. When untilDate is omitted, today in the client's time zone (header x-time-zone, otherwise UTC) is used; the answer names the resolved date and zone. Paging: limit (default 50, at most 500) and offset (default 0); page.nextOffset is null on the last page and page.totalCount counts the whole selection.", annotations=) public io.modelcontextprotocol.spec.McpSchema.CallToolResult holdings(@McpToolParam(required=false,description="Valuation date yyyy-MM-dd, default today") String untilDate, @McpToolParam(required=false,description="Include positions closed before the date, default false") Boolean includeClosedPositions, @McpToolParam(required=false,description="currency (default), assetclasstype, specialinvestmentinstrument or assetclass") String groupBy, @McpToolParam(required=false,description="Restrict to one portfolio; its currency becomes the main currency") Integer idPortfolio, @McpToolParam(required=false,description="Sort field with optional :asc or :desc") String orderBy, @McpToolParam(required=false,description="Rows per page, 1 to 500, default 50") Integer limit, @McpToolParam(required=false,description="First row, default 0") Integer offset)

    • periodPerformance

      @McpTool(name="period_performance", description="Performance of the whole tenant or of one portfolio between two dates, as the period performance report of the user interface calculates it. firstDay and lastDay hold the totals on the first and the last day, difference the change in between: totalBalanceMC (cash plus securities), externalCashTransferMC (deposits minus withdrawals), gainMC and totalGainMC, dividendRealMC, interestCashaccountRealMC, feeRealMC. metrics holds the time-weighted return twrPercent, the money-weighted return mwrPercent, the maximum drawdown, the annualized volatility and the fee ratio, all in percentage points; a figure that cannot be determined is null. periods splits the range into weeks or years with their gain and time-weighted return. The range must lie within the trading days for which prices exist.Fields ending in MC are amounts in the main currency (mainCurrency); amounts without MC are in the currency of the instrument or account. Percentages are percentage points (12.5 means 12.5 %).", annotations=) public io.modelcontextprotocol.spec.McpSchema.CallToolResult periodPerformance(@McpToolParam(description="First day yyyy-MM-dd") String dateFrom, @McpToolParam(description="Last day yyyy-MM-dd") String dateTo, @McpToolParam(required=false,description="week or year (default)") String periodSplit, @McpToolParam(required=false,description="Restrict to one portfolio") Integer idPortfolio)

      @McpTool(name="security_transactions", description="The transactions of the tenant in one security up to a date, with the position summary at that date: units, value, gain/loss and the cumulative currency result gainLossCurrencyMC. Paging: limit (default 50, at most 500) and offset (default 0); page.nextOffset is null on the last page and page.totalCount counts the whole selection.", annotations=) public io.modelcontextprotocol.spec.McpSchema.CallToolResult securityTransactions(@McpToolParam(description="Id of the security (idSecuritycurrency)") Integer idSecuritycurrency, @McpToolParam(required=false,description="Last day yyyy-MM-dd, default today") String untilDate, @McpToolParam(required=false,description="transactionTime:asc or transactionTime:desc") String orderBy, @McpToolParam(required=false,description="Rows per page, 1 to 500, default 50") Integer limit, @McpToolParam(required=false,description="First row, default 0") Integer offset)

      @McpTool(name="cashaccount_transactions", description="The bookings of one cash account in one calendar year, optionally restricted to transaction types (WITHDRAWAL, DEPOSIT, INTEREST_CASHACCOUNT, FEE, ACCUMULATE, REDUCE, DIVIDEND, FINANCE_COST, ACCRUED_INTEREST).     • findInstrument

      @McpTool(name="find_instrument", description="Finds securities or currency pairs that exist in Grafioschtrader. For securities the text is matched against the name, the ISIN and the ticker symbol; every match carries its id, ISIN, currency and stock exchange (MIC), so instruments of the same name can be told apart. For currency pairs pass a currency code or both, for example EUR/CHF. At most 20 matches are returned; moreAvailable true means the list is cut and the text should be narrowed.", annotations=) public io.modelcontextprotocol.spec.McpSchema.CallToolResult findInstrument(@McpToolParam(description="Search text, at least 2 characters") String text, @McpToolParam(required=false,description="security (default) or currencypair") String kind)
